diagnosis: The browser session replay endpoint takes a client-supplied userSessionId and restores saved Playwright browser state (containing authentication cookies and local storage tokens) from the filesystem without verifying that the requesting user owns or has delegated access to that session. An attacker can supply arbitrary session identifiers to capture screenshots of active authenticated pages belonging to other users.
